# JSTOR

> JSTOR is a comprehensive digital library providing access to academic journals, books, primary sources, and research tools for scholars and institutions worldwide.

JSTOR offers a vast collection of scholarly resources across multiple disciplines, supported by ITHAKA and integrated with tools like Artstor for visual collections and LibGuides for research instruction. The platform serves academics, librarians, and students through both traditional access and innovative digital humanities projects.

## Key Topics

- JSTOR digital library
- Academic journals
- Primary sources
- Research platform
- LibGuides

## Core Platform

- [JSTOR Home](https://logon.jstor.org/): JSTOR digital library homepage for academic journals, books, and primary sources
- [JSTOR Labs](https://labstest.jstor.org/): JSTOR Labs innovation hub for research tools and digital humanities projects

## Research & Teaching Guides

- [LibGuides Home](https://guides.jstor.org/home): JSTOR LibGuides home with teaching resources, research basics, and how-to guides
- [Library Access Success Guide](https://guides.jstor.org/for-libraries/remote): Library success guide for JSTOR remote access and digital preservation setup
